scope: IE-04/05/06/08 atomic readout comparison, not replacement of gate dynamics or compression of physical memory.
decision: Determine whether vectorized exact algebra removes the apparent readout bottleneck and whether a learned aperture operator provides additional fidelity-qualified resident savings.
input_contract: Same post-update 18 gates and 11 gbar multipliers. Learned shared per-channel MLP sees gathered m,h,power/4,has_h. Exact arms see the same available information. V is used only in the identical analytic current and membrane laws. No teacher endpoint is an online input.
data_contract: Independent IID uniform [0,1] gate states for atomic fit/development/fresh; fresh is evaluated only after checkpoint freeze. Historical Task35 trajectories are opened diagnostic data, never called a sealed biological test.
model: Four inputs, one SiLU hidden layer width16 or32, sigmoid aperture. Six members (two widths x three seeds) train together with paired minibatches, independent Adam moments and clipping. Padding is removed for timed inference.
selection: Each member independently minimizes development aperture RMSE across registered checkpoints; fresh never selects. Fixed budget; no rerun of a failed seed.
validation: Exact vectorized readout must agree with legacy within gsum 1e-10 and gEsum 1e-8; compiled/graph checks use V .002mV, Ca 1e-8mM, gates 2e-5, gsum1e-10, gEsum1e-8. A technical failure is not scientific NO-GO. Missing graph comparison is inconclusive for that mode.
exclusions: No speedup claim for online recurrence, host RNG, transfers, native NEURON, full morphology, new temporal grain, or entire ionic dynamics. Formula gate update, calcium/SK ordering, synapses and membrane solver remain fixed. Uniform gate states are a controlled atomic domain, not physiological occupancy. Historical rollout is diagnostic and cannot authorize deployment.
